title: Confirming a meeting time sends every attendee a calendar invite and frees the other options

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; owner ask 2026-11-24 17:35Z: AI meeting and date management so everyone can brainstorm the best date and time)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: after a team picks a date there is no confirm step: the other pencils stay held until they lapse, and attendees get nothing to put in their own calendar. Fix: confirmTimeOption makes the winner the Plan's date, releases the rest of the option_group, and emails each attendee (members and EMAIL-092 voters) an .ics invite, as booking confirmations already do.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
